name: The Whisper In Their Eyes
source:
Ronan Isidro has dedicated his life to the cause of his great empire and nation, Yhafa.

His life is simple, his work well defined for him, and he has a loving wife who is pregnant with his child. 

A simple life. 

A well-defined life.         

A healthy life. 

A mapped-out life. 

A picture-perfect life. 

A life that lives in an image of its own, and advertises itself on the posters of Yhafa. Everything was as he wanted, as what Mother Yhafa wanted. 

So what will happen, when a mysterious photograph arrives on his doorstep out of nowhere.

Surely, a photograph could not cause any harm to this perfect, healthy, life.

[From [url=https://team-awkward-smile.itch.io/the-whisper-in-their-eyes]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
罗南·伊西德罗 (Ronan Isidro) 将一生奉献给了他伟大的帝国和国家亚法 (Yhafa) 的事业。

他的生活很简单，他的工作对他来说很明确，他有一个慈爱的妻子，怀着他的孩子。

简单的生活。

明确的生活。

健康的生活。

规划好的生活。

完美的生活。

生活在自己的形象中，并在Yhafa的海报上宣传自己。一切都如他所愿，如雅法母亲所愿。

那么，当一张神秘照片突然出现在他家门口时，会发生什么呢？

当然，一张照片不会对这个完美、健康的生活造成任何伤害。
